en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing the front façade of a large church with a rose window, classical pediment, and ornate portal. A bell tower with a dome rises behind the façade. There are a few people walking in the open square in front of the church, with trees and surrounding buildings visible. Printed captions appear along the bottom margin naming the location and church.
